developer.name: Claude (Anthropic) and the Wisp Player contributors

description.p: Wisp Player plays the music already on your computer: gapless, with a small memory footprint and no web view or GPU context. It was designed and written by Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic.

ul.li: Gapless playback of MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC, Ogg Vorbis, Opus, ALAC and AIFF files, and of the sound of MP4, WebM and MKV videos
Synchronized lyrics that follow the song, from .lrc files or the file's own tags
Albums, artists and playlists, with search that ignores case and accents
35 themes, from Catppuccin and Nord to Winamp and Windows 95, plus one that takes its colors from the album cover
A tag editor for songs without proper tags: it flags them, looks each one up on request, and only changes a file when you press Save

description.p: First release for Linux. The same player now also runs on Android phones and tablets.
